title: Real Estate App Long Case Study
whatItIs: An extremely tall white case study: a black gloved hand holding a map-based property app, research stats with ring gauges, a full-width house photo, orange-bezel phones showing filters, a persona block and a closing hero with 'Find your new home'.
whatItMeans: A restrained white page with photos and orange-edged devices keeps a long story clean and readable.
techniques: Dark hero image opening a very white page
Full-bleed real photo as a break
Copper phone frames repeated as a motif
Persona portrait beside short need statements

vocabulary.definition: A circular progress ring showing a percentage.
An image extending to the edges of the canvas.
A repeated device bezel colour used across images.
